About Ratn Grah Udyog

Empowering Incense Business Under Leadership of Upendra Dwivedi

Founded by Mr. Upendra Dwivedi, Ratn Grah Udyog (Rewa, Madhya Pradesh) has grown into a premiere B2B partner for incense manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers across India. We provide top-grade Agarbatti, Fragrance Oils, Bamboo Sticks, Agarbatti Masala, Printed Covers, and Automatic Machinery with end-to-end plant setup support.
